query:
INSERT INTO requirement_chunk (requirement_id, chunk_id)
               SELECT r.id, c.id
               FROM requirement r
               JOIN chunk c ON c.id = ANY($3)
               WHERE r.id = $2
                 AND r.user_id = $1
                 AND c.user_id = $1
               ON CONFLICT (requirement_id, chunk_id) DO NOTHING
               RETURNING requirement_id, chunk_id
